title: TETHERBOUND
closing: You and your companions are home. The roads you reopened belong to their people again.
layout_note: Values use the 1920x1080 project canvas: at the 1280x720 stress raster, margins are 48px, title 44px and body 24px.

homecoming.starter_present: %s, the companion you chose here, is still beside you.
homecoming.starter_absent: Your first companion took another road. That beginning still matters.
homecoming.starter_unknown: That first beginning still matters. I will not guess which road your first companion took.
homecoming.memory_empty: This company is home with you. There is room here to make more memories together.

memories.line: %s has discovered %d landmarks with you. You have seen a great deal together.
%s has stood with you through %d battles. I am glad you both made it home.
You and %s have shared %d nights of rest. Quiet care is part of a journey, too.
You have cared for %s through %d meals. That care belongs in their story.

homecoming.choices_empty: Those you met had their own wishes. Their invitations were yours to answer.

choices.meadows:accepted: You welcomed Veridian when it chose to follow you.
choices.meadows:refused: You let Veridian choose its own road.

_comment_guest_ack_timeout_seconds: A guest's acknowledgement is a host round trip (fresh personal view, send, host durable save, row delivery). On a slow frame rate (CI at ~1 fps) 8 s ran out before the first view reply (F18 #4, CI 37298008163 shard 5). The host's own ack commits in-frame and keeps ack_timeout_seconds.
